'''TY-4N''' was a [[Zakuul]]an [[skytrooper]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] once deployed by the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
TY-4N appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Cartel companion available from the Scavenger Alliance Pack, added with Patch 4.7.3.
